title: The contract of a function
description: The contract that a function declares, and the description of a worker that carries them (docs/total5.md, docs/how-it-works.md).

contract.description: What a function declares about itself. The names are the same in every language: @action(...) in Python, .summary().input() in Rust, .Summary().Input() in Go.

summary.description: One line for people and for the AI agent that reads the tool.

input.description: The schema of the input in the syntax of Total.js: "*text:String // The text". * means required. Total.js validates it before the function runs.

output.description: The schema of what the function returns.

query.description: The schema of the query string. With query or params declared, the function receives { input, query, params }.

params.description: The schema of the parameters of the route.

mcp.description: Offer the function to AI agents as an MCP tool. Off unless true.

permissions.description: Who may call: "admin,editor", any of them.

user.description: True: only a logged in user. False: only an anonymous one.

idempotent.description: The call can be repeated on another worker if its worker dies.

timeout.description: Longest time of a call, in milliseconds.

id.description: The name of the action in Total.js, if it should not be module/function.

describe.description: What a worker prints with --describe and what fusion.describe(runtime) resolves: the contracts, read without running any function.

stream.description: True for a generator (Python) or a stream function (Rust, Go): it is read with fusion.stream() and is not an action.

functions.description: How many functions the worker has, with or without a contract.

errors.description: Problems that were found: a syntax error, a function registered twice.

sdk.description: The version of the SDK that built the worker.
